key.name: retention-days
key.description: Number of days to keep usage data. 0 means keep forever.

key.name: max-interval
key.description: Maximum interval between focus events before capping to prevent skewed data after suspend.

key.name: idle-timeout
key.description: Stop counting after this long without keyboard or mouse input, even while the screen stays on. Time up to the timeout is still counted. 0 disables idle detection.

key.name: day-start-hour
key.description: Time tracked before this hour counts towards the previous day, so work that runs past midnight stays on the day it started. 0 is midnight, the plain calendar day.

key.name: percent-basis
key.summary: What row percentages and bars are relative to
key.description: "total" compares each row with its parent's total (the day for apps); "largest" compares with the biggest row at that level, so the top item reads 100%. Toggled by clicking the total card in the popup.

key.name: purge-requested
key.description: Internal, not user-facing. Set by the prefs UI to a unix timestamp to request an immediate one-time deletion of usage data older than 7 days.

key.name: prefs-focus
key.summary: Where Preferences should put focus when it opens
key.description: Internal, not user-facing. Set to "add-client" by the popup's Add client row. Preferences focuses its Add a client field and resets the key to "".

key.name: show-total-in-panel
key.summary: Show today's total in the panel
key.description: When enabled the panel shows the icon plus today's total screen time; when disabled only the icon is shown.

key.name: app-limits
key.description: Maps an application id to a daily limit in minutes. When today's tracked time for that app reaches its limit, a one-time notification is shown for the rest of the day.

key.name: interval-retention-days
key.description: How long the per-day activity timeline behind each clock session is kept. Sessions themselves are never deleted; past this many days a session keeps its hours but loses its breakdown. 0 keeps the timeline forever.

key.name: clients
key.description: One entry per client: name, whether it is offered in the popup, and a third value that is no longer used (it was a billable flag, kept so stored lists still load). Every client on the list is exported.

key.name: last-client
key.description: Internal, not user-facing. What the popup's clock control and the keyboard shortcut start when no client is named.

key.name: toggle-clock
key.description: Keyboard shortcut that stops the running clock, or starts the most recently used client. Unset by default, because many combinations are already claimed by the desktop.

key.name: panel-time
key.summary: What the panel shows next to the icon
key.description: "screen" shows today's total screen time, "client" shows the running clock (or today's clocked total when the clock is stopped), "none" shows only the icon. A dot marks a running clock in every mode.

key.name: panel-time-migrated
key.description: Internal, not user-facing. Set once panel-time has taken its value from the older show-total-in-panel boolean.

key.name: clock-nudge-minutes
key.summary: Nudge after this long idle while clocked in
key.description: The clock keeps running while you are away, so a notification offers to stop it after this many minutes without input. 0 disables the nudge.
